dashboard.title: Shift
dashboard.placeholder: Work-hours tracking is on its way.

weekly_hours.label: Weekly hours
weekly_hours.description: Contract hours per week, split evenly over your workdays.

work_week.label: Work week
work_week.description: Days your contract expects you to work.

day_start_hour.label: Workday starts at
day_start_hour.description: Hour (0–12) at which a new workday begins. Work before it counts toward the previous day.

command.title: Shift did not respond
command.body: Your action did not reach the Shift service. Try again, or disable and re-enable the plugin.

overlap.title: Session not recorded
overlap.body: It overlaps a session that is already recorded, probably because the system clock changed.

unavailable.title: Shift cannot save data
unavailable.body: The plugin data folder is unavailable ({file}). Tracked time will not be saved.

unreadable.title: Shift data is unreadable
unreadable.body: {file} exists but cannot be read. Shift will not save anything until this is fixed.

corrupt.title: Shift data was damaged
corrupt.body: {file} could not be parsed and was renamed with a .corrupt suffix. Shift continues without its contents.

corrupt_stuck.title: Shift data was damaged
corrupt_stuck.body: {file} could not be parsed nor renamed. Shift will not save anything until it is repaired or removed.

newer.title: Shift data is from a newer version
newer.body: {file} was written by a newer version of Shift. Update the plugin; nothing will be saved until then.

write.title: Shift could not save data
write.body: Writing {file} failed. Recent changes may be lost if Noctalia stops.
